ops.body: Published indexed matching coherence implementation in PR284 at a25cce362f62446bcd0128ab57bf3c52e33f88f7; follow-up b9eab257a548 fixes fixture preallocation warnings. Core consumed-source cursor uses immutable sourcegraph Diff under managed write transaction and folds changed answers only; native writers advance an already-current cursor atomically, preserving pending old-client writes. Answer schema alone moves to9; other kinds keep8. Answer StatusMetadata uses the same synchronized indexed transaction. Actual immutable-v8 process regression keeps its Store open across new reindex, tests edit/delete/native interleaving, exact changed-body projection counts, preserved note writes and fresh answer status. Added a separate hosted acceptance job so its results/cost logs are available without waiting for unrelated full-suite failures. One bounded independent follow-up reviewer is active for the concrete P1 resolution. Source hooks pass after preallocation fixes. Not yet released or installed; CPU acceptance remains open. Existing sessions/services and monorepo remain untouched.
